description: Antropico - Ponte/Viadotto/Cavalcavia (sede viaria) is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. Il dataset contiene: PontSe: Ponte/Viadotto/Cavalcavia (sede viaria); (classe Pont, presenta tre componenti spaziali, pontSp (sapplette) pontSo (sostegno) e pontSe (sede viaria) con geometria PolygonZ) Si tratta della rappresentazione delle opere costruite per il collegamento viario: di lati opposti di corsi d’acqua, di sovrappasso di altre entità o infrastrutture, per il superamento di zone depresse del ... Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are antropico, cartografia, celerimetrico, comune-firenze, eu. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
